EVENT_DESCRIPTION_PT: O USGS registrou em 13 de novembro de 2026 as 12:37:49 UTC (07:37 horario local) um sismo de magnitude 4,4 mb com epicentro proximo a Oventeni, provincia de Atalaya, regiao Ucayali (coordenadas -10,5256/-74,6131, referencia USGS '52 km NE de Santa Rosa'), a 125,8 km de profundidade (evento USGS us7000ty0j). EVENT_DESCRIPTION_EN: USGS recorded a magnitude 4.4 mb earthquake on November 13, 2026 at 12:37:49 UTC (07:37 local time), epicenter near Oventeni, Atalaya province, Ucayali region (coordinates -10.5256/-74.6131, USGS reference '52 km NE of Santa Rosa'), depth 125.8 km (USGS event us7000ty0j). It was not mentioned in the IGP live report consulted this cycle (which listed only the Loreto, Huánuco and Ica quakes from the same day), so it remains single-sourced to the international USGS network; no deaths, injuries or material damage were reported.
